live_predictions.description: Application-facing live prediction table. It stores only the currently configured runtime model output with stable generic column names.

column_docs.open_time: UTC minute timestamp copied from the features table.
column_docs.close: Close price copied from the features table for app display.
column_docs.target: The target value copied from the runtime model's configured target_name column in the features table.
column_docs.prediction: The runtime model probability for its configured target.
column_docs.signal: Trading label derived from prediction and the configured signal threshold.

signal.direction_source: Inferred from the runtime model target_name prefix: trg_l_ emits LONG above threshold, trg_s_ emits SHORT above threshold.
signal.note: Tune this threshold with model evaluation before using it as a live trading cutoff.

evaluation_predictions.description: Model comparison predictions should be generated outside the live predictions table.
evaluation_predictions.recommended_storage: Model/evaluation artifacts under models/<model_id>/ or a future narrow evaluation table.
